2228-4279-6094.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-4279-6094.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-4279-6094.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

4268-4499-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

851-967-3809-6495-7087.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
851-967-3809-6495-7087.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

765-833-1059-3827.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace, Grand Warlord Radha, and at least three additional creatures you control can attack without taking damage.
765-833-1059-3827.description:
Declare Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Grand Warlord Radha trigger, adding at least five mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Guildless Commons, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1594-4399-4518-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1594-4399-4518-6458.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Thunder of Unity trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4518-6458.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

598-2511-5173.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
Shambing Ghast dies, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

7686-7730-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
7686-7730-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
7686-7730-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2421-3705-4050-7729.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix and The Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Skyfire Phoenix trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

5789-6996-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5789-6996-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

141-6798-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-6798-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-6798-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

80-117-1618-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Talrand
80-117-1618-2440.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Venture Forth.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Talrand triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Venture Forth.
Repeat.
80-117-1618-2440.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Talrand. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

679-3017-6282.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in your graveyard.
You have a way to lose life.
679-3017-6282.description:
Lose life by any method.
Lich's Mastery's second ability triggers, causing you to exile a card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and draw a card.
Lich's Mastery second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Resolve the Lich's Mastery trigger, exiling a card from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7154.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

4970-5671-5751-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
4970-5671-5751-6747.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
4970-5671-5751-6747.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1349-2921-4153.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional nontoken creatures, one of which has a coin counter on it.
1349-2921-4153.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Athreos trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter on another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature that died in step 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2018-2111-5315.easyPrerequisites:
You control a black creature.
You do not control a blue creature.
2018-2111-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Wingrattle Scarecrow didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Wingrattle Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Wingrattle Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

186-2060-2265-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
186-2060-2265-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1636-3143-3848-5696.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-3848-5696.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Omnath trigger.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1806-2382-4050-5465.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {1}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

539-1434-2391-4438-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Beledros.
Beledros and Oracle of Nectars do not have summoning sickness.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {11}.
539-1434-2391-4438-4702.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {11}.
Activate Oracle of Nectars by paying {10} and tapping it, causing you to gain ten life.
Activate Beledros by paying ten life, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Beledros by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.

2104-2187-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Possessed Skaab.
2104-2187-4305.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Possessed Skaab.
Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand.
Repeat.

3240-4050-4314.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
3240-4050-4314.notes: You may also sacrifice the Eldrazi Spawns to their own abilities.
